nodes.description: address private owner; privileged account used for access checks in a number of functions
address tradeAddress; address that is whitelisted in ensure() and set by setTradeAddress()
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spend approvals mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic
uint256 private _saleNum; per-address sale count limit used in condition()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer value enforced in condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer value enforced in condition()
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; counter incremented on every transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; per-address whitelist consulted by ensure()
uint public totalSupply; total token supply
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used by init()
string public name; token name
string public symbol; token symbol
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...; Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure()
transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; performs allowance and balance mutations with raw unchecked arithmetic
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist bypass logic letting owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses skip condition()
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale transfer limits
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without restriction
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-supplied address and calldata
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public; owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only bulk transfer with unchecked multiplication and balance updates
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-only update of the whitelisted tradeAddress
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes the deterministic Uniswap pair address used for the whitelist
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; mints the full supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
msg.sender; external caller address used as authorization subject and as transfer sender
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes arbitrary external code in the storage context of this contract
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction in transferFrom()
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction in transferFrom()
balanceOf[_to] += _value; raw unchecked addition in transferFrom()
uint total = _value * _tos.length; unchecked multiplication in batchSend()
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total; raw unchecked subtraction in batchSend()
balanceOf[_to] += _value; raw unchecked addition per recipient in batchSend()
_from parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint)
_to parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint)
_value parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint)
a parameter of delegate(address,bytes); target of the delegatecall
b parameter of delegate(address,bytes); calldata of the delegatecall
saleNum parameter of init(uint256,uint256,uint256)
token parameter of init(uint256,uint256,uint256) used as _minSale
maxToken parameter of init(uint256,uint256,uint256) used as _maxSale
_tos parameter of batchSend(address[],uint)
_value parameter of batchSend(address[],uint)
addr parameter of setTradeAddress(address)
uint total local variable in batchSend() holding _value * _tos.length
address _UNI local variable in ensure() holding the computed Uniswap pair address

edges.reason: transfer() immediately calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value), so users reach the raw-arithmetic path through transfer
msg.sender is supplied as the _from argument of transferFrom, tying caller identity to balance mutation
approve() stores allowance[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller controls the allowance owner key
delegate() gates the arbitrary delegatecall only on msg.sender == owner
init() gates sale-limit reconfiguration only on msg.sender == owner
batchSend() gates bulk balance redistribution only on msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress() gates the whitelist update only on msg.sender == owner
the constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged account
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath, allowing unchecked underflow
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath, allowing unchecked underflow
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath, allowing unchecked overflow/arbitrary minting of balances
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from], which is the counter enforced by condition()
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no restriction
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the whitelisted Uniswap pair for address(this)
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses only
ensure() returns true when _from or _to equals owner, fully bypassing the sale-limit checks
ensure() whitelists any transfer involving tradeAddress, allowing the owner to grant unlimited bypass rights
ensure() returns true whenever canSale[_from] is set, bypassing condition()
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether the per-address sale cap applies
condition() reads _minSale as the minimum allowed transfer value
condition() reads _maxSale as the maximum allowed transfer value
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) to an arbitrary address after only an owner check, giving full storage control to that address
init() assigns _minSale from the token argument scaled by decimals
init() assigns _maxSale from the maxToken argument scaled by decimals
init() assigns _saleNum directly from the saleNum argument
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow of the total
batchSend() performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath
batchSend() performs balanceOf[_to] += _value per recipient without SafeMath
batchSend() reads and rewrites the balanceOf mapping for caller and recipients
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress, which ensure() treats as an unconditional whitelist entry
the constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role used by delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress
the constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
the constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router
the constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the transferFrom sender argument, so it is folded into the transferFrom function node
_to is only meaningful as the transferFrom recipient argument, so it is folded into the transferFrom function node
_value is only meaningful as the amount driving unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom
the delegatecall target parameter is inseparable from the delegate() unsafe operation
the delegatecall calldata parameter is inseparable from the delegate() unsafe operation
saleNum flows directly into the _saleNum state variable written by init()
token flows directly into the _minSale state variable written by init()
maxToken flows directly into the _maxSale state variable written by init()
_tos drives the loop bounds and total computation inside batchSend()
_value is the multiplier of the unchecked total computation inside batchSend()
addr is written straight into the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable
the local total exists only inside batchSend() and feeds its unchecked balance subtraction
the local _UNI exists only inside ensure() and feeds the whitelist comparison
